notes.title: DEMO & Steam Next Fest is here!
notes.content: [p][u][b]Get ready to platform through the constellations of space in the Luminescence DEMO![/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Experience 11 hand-selected levels from the first 3 worlds[/p][/*][*][p]Earn an exclusive skin by playing the demo before Luminescence's release[/p][/*][*][p]Compete with your friends and others for the best times on dedicated Steam leaderboards[/p][/*][*][p]Get an early look at what's to come in the main game![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="3fY8hap3g2M;full"][/previewyoutube][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][u]Luminescence's demo is participating in Steam Next Fest![/u][/b][/p][p]Look forward to frequent improvements and updates across the festival period[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42589608/8b8536593160af6f6fb8bab7304883b8c49b9a78.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you have any feedback, problems or ideas for Luminescence and its featured demo, please let us know in Steam discussions. See you on the leaderboards! [/p]
